features: 【TRIPLE MODE CONNECTIVITY】 Say goodbye to the hassle of using multiple mice for each device! With the cutting edge and advance technology Offbeat brings you the latest and best version of a wireless mouse. It support-connect 3 devices simultaneously with a push of button. It pairs seamlessly with three connectivity options to choose from: 2.4Ghz Nano USB and 2 Bluetooth channels (5.1 and 5.1)

【TYPE C CHARGING WITH NO EXTERNAL BATTERY】 It has an in-built Rechargeable Li-ion battery and does not require any external battery. Once the battery drains you can plug the type C charging cable provided to charge it (60 mins). To save power and for long-term usage, the mouse will automatically enter into the sleep mode after 11 minutes of inactivity, it can be woken up by clicking any button.

【SILENT CLICK & SLIM DESIGN】 Silent click Mouse with anti-fingerprint finish offers you’re the most premium feel. Silent button reduces 90% noises, which makes it an ideal wireless mouse for office and personal use. Symmetric and ergonomic design makes this mouse fit for both left and right hand, naturally curved grip of the mouse makes it comfortable and perfect, avoids hand fatigue for long term use. Slim and portable design makes the mouse your best travel companion.

【PLUG/PLAY WITH BATTERY INDICATOR】No need to install any driver, just plug the USB receiver into your laptop or connect with Bluetooth and the mouse starts to serve. Advanced technology provides powerful and reliable connection with 3 devices at the same time, effective up to 10 meters of range. Advanced Optical Tracking Technology ensures greater sensitivity for precise tracking on a wide range of surfaces. Battery indicator at the bottom of the mouse.

【UNIVERSAL WIDE COMPATIBILITY】Atom can work with many devices, it supports almost all the OS systems - Windows, IOS, Android, Linux, Ubuntu. You can connect to any device you like such as Mac book, Mac book Pro, Laptop/PC, Ipad, Tablet, Smart TV, Smart box, Mobile.
